name: comb_hierarchy_budget

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: Remote fixture proving a complete hierarchical combinational source closure.

description: Compile and simulate a three-operation representative after separate hierarchical source-closure probes.
behavior: Compute i_a AND i_b as the first operation.
OR the intermediate with i_c as the second operation.
Invert the two-operation intermediate to form a three-operation simulation fixture.
constraints: Keep the representative simulation operation cone at three operations.
notes: Sibling .v files are quality-gate probes and are intentionally excluded from simulation outputs.
